summary: Renders a debug text overlay: clears a 64-byte stack buffer, formats several fields into it with four formatter helpers, and draws them as colored lines at screen-relative X offsets derived from a1 (one line in yellow at a1+50, the remaining white lines at a1+325 at Y positions 50 and 90, each drawn twice with swapped alignment flags), plus one secondary overlay element via DoubleRenderPass.

local_names.a1: screen X base offset for the overlay group
local_names.v2: 64-byte stack text buffer reused for each rendered field
local_names.0xFFFFFF: white text colour (first line uses 16776960 yellow)
local_names.formatter helpers: sub_49C310/sub_49C370/sub_49C490/sub_49C4E0 fill the buffer with individual debug fields

operations.description: Render the first (yellow) line: UITextRenderWithScale(v2, a1 + 50, 46, 16776960, 2, 0, 0.75, 1.0) draws the buffer at X = a1+50, Y = 46 with yellow colour and 0.75 scale
Render a secondary overlay element: DoubleRenderPass(a1 + 325, 10)
Format debug field 1 into the buffer: sub_49C310(v2, 64)
Format debug field 2 into the buffer: sub_49C370(v2, 64)
Render field 2 with swapped alignment: UITextRenderWithScale(v2, a1 + 325, 50, 0xFFFFFF, 0, 1, 1.0, 1.0)
Format debug field 3 into the buffer: sub_49C490(v2, 64)
Format debug field 4 into the buffer: sub_49C4E0(v2, 64)
Render field 4 with swapped alignment and return its result: UITextRenderWithScale(v2, a1 + 325, 90, 0xFFFFFF, 0, 1, 1.0, 1.0)
